entries.speaker: Scared Female Student
entries.en: Shibuya's been getting more and more[n]dangerous, right? I'm scared to go home[n]alone...

entries.speaker: Carefree Female Student
entries.en: Yeah, I heard it's because of the mafia.[n]They're even forcing girls to work as[n]prostitutes for them.

entries.speaker: Scared Female Student
entries.en: I can't believe there's drug dealers[n]in Shibuya now. I wish someone[n]would get rid of them...

entries.speaker: Carefree Female Student
entries.en: Maybe we should ask the Phantom[n]Thieves? They fight for justice,[n]take down bad guys, right?
